title: The lot, full
logline: Tourist Season: Gully's gravel lot full of rentals and the Legacy boxed in at the back, the pup on its hood in the sun. A man in plaid from behind at the lot's edge waiting for a car to move. It doesn't in this page.

panels.composition: A gravel lot full of rental cars with a faded green station wagon boxed in at the back, a small three-legged dog lying on its hood, a man in plaid from behind at the lot's edge waiting.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gravel lot full of rental cars with a faded green station wagon boxed in at the back and a small three-legged dog lying on its hood, a man in plaid flannel seen from behind at the lot's edge waiting, no words
